extracted.name: Pasta and Garlic
extracted.description: This is one of those dishes that defies explanation. Pasta, garlic, olive oil and a sprinkling of cheese. How could only four ingredients taste so wonderful? An Italian miracle.
ingredient_lines: 2 cloves garlic, crushed, or more to taste
instruction_lines: In a large pot of salted water boil pasta until al dente. Drain well.
In a small saucepan heat oil slightly, add garlic. Saute garlic until it is lightly browned. Be careful not to burn garlic.
Combine pasta and garlic, salt and pepper to taste. Top with Parmesan or Romano cheese and serve.
